description: list_get success payload: 2-byte big-endian entry count followed by that many 6-byte entries (LDN, LSN BE, type), sorted by listed DN then SN. The count is 2 bytes because a list may hold up to 1000 entries. Empty list = count 0 with status 250.

response_empty.note: count 0; status 250 (list exists but is empty)
